calibration.surprise_note: The negative breadth filter removed winners across all three canonical windows and the holdout; additionally, the shared BacktestEngine resolver coupled entry eligibility into one COIN add-on checkpoint, independently invalidating the locked entry-only attribution.

change_summary: Implemented and evaluated a shared default-off SEC N-PORT independent holder-breadth fresh-entry eligibility policy across three canonical windows and a separate frozen holdout.
hypothesis: SEC N-PORT public-holdings filing-date PIT independent ownership breadth should identify weakening institutional sponsorship: with at least 20 matched continuously reporting fund series, a negative (bought-from-zero minus sold-to-zero) breadth makes only a fresh core candidate ineligible at its next open; missing or zero breadth passes, while existing positions, add-ons, exits, sizing, ordering, and costs stay unchanged. The shared default-off helper should improve the active cash-feasible strategy across all three canonical windows and confirm direction on the frozen unseen 2026-04-22..2026-07-16 holdout.
next_retry_requires: a genuinely different data source rather than threshold or response retuning on the frozen N-PORT surface
materially new settled forward rows supporting a distinct economic mechanism and an adapter that cannot affect add-ons
notes: Rejected. Negative holder breadth touched 47 canonical fresh candidates and 8 holdout candidates, but aggregate EV fell 6.2057 to 4.7736, PnL fell by 19570.78 USD, every canonical window and the holdout regressed, and the shared resolver suppressed one COIN add-on checkpoint. Daily parity passed on 51 candidate dates and Gate 2/3 passed. Do not retune the sign, threshold, minimum series, report gap, exclusion response, or notional response on this frozen N-PORT surface. Reopen only with a genuinely different data source or materially new settled forward rows supporting a new economic mechanism. The reusable helper remains trade-inert; the experiment-only daily run adapter was rolled back.

prediction.confidence_reason: Outcome-blind preflight found negative breadth on 13/12/14 canonical candidates and 8 of 20 unseen holdout candidates, including five entered trades; however the prior N-PORT aggregate-share scalar failed every window and a hard exclusion can remove winners.
